scope: Append-only precision corrections to R468's 500 source-correct catalog comments (13 interpretation refinements). Only named categorical/interpretation fields superseded; do not replace or invalidate full texts, OIDs, MD5s, rank continuity or other reviewed entries.
reason: Post-readback category consistency review identified pg_stat_file as telemetry, nonblocking advisory locks as statistics/generic metadata, and array_to_json as bit operators; restore exact semantics and distinguish mutating server APIs.

corrections.signature: pg_catalog.pg_stat_file(filename text, OUT size bigint, OUT access timestamp with time zone, OUT modification timestamp with time zone, OUT change timestamp with time zone, OUT creation timestamp with time zone, OUT isdir boolean)
corrections.correct_interpretation: pg_stat_file(filename): reports server-file metadata (size, times and type); NOT a SQL statement execution counter. File access was not invoked.

corrections.correct_interpretation: pg_try_advisory_lock(bigint) attempts a session-level exclusive advisory lock nonblocking. Declaration only; no lock taken.

corrections.correct_interpretation: pg_try_advisory_lock_shared(bigint) attempts a session-level shared advisory lock nonblocking. Declaration only; no lock taken.

corrections.full_description: obtain exclusive advisory lock if available
corrections.correct_interpretation: pg_try_advisory_lock(int,int) attempts a session-level exclusive advisory lock nonblocking with composite key. Declaration only; no lock taken.

corrections.full_description: obtain shared advisory lock if available
corrections.correct_interpretation: pg_try_advisory_lock_shared(int,int) attempts a session-level shared advisory lock nonblocking with composite key. Declaration only; no lock taken.

array_to_json(anyarray) serializes an array as JSON; it does NOT perform array overlap, contains or bitstring edits. Not executed on member data.

corrections.correct_interpretation: array_to_json(anyarray,boolean) serializes an array as JSON with optional pretty formatting; NOT an array/bitstring edit. Not executed on member data.
